Chapter 708 - 708 Universe Competition; Sparring!

Chapter 708 - 708 Universe Competition; Sparring!

708 Universe Competition; Sparring!

The man known as the Heavenly Emperor swept his gaze across the crowd with a pair of eyes that were as bright as the sun.

Everyone he saw felt their hearts beating faster.

After a while, the Celestial Thearch continued, “The universe competition will begin in a hundred years. This time, the universe competition will receive the attention of all the Saint Lords. Let the geniuses of the various worlds prepare and perform well.”

“Yes, sir!” Everyone said in unison.

Then, countless pieces of news quickly arrived in many worlds like meteors.

All the worlds were in an uproar.

The cultivation craze continued to surge.

That was because they knew very well… what it meant for the Saint Lords to pay attention?

If they were lucky enough to be chosen by the Saint Lords, it would definitely be a matter of reaching the heavens in a single step.

…

In the blink of an eye, several years passed.

[Ding! Congratulations, it’s been 42 years since you’ve received the advanced system. Reward: Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem, 100 million EXP, Immortal Crystal x1.]

After another Immortal Crystal appeared, the spiritual energy in the Coiling Dragon Villa became even denser.

“Finally, I got another Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem.” Lin Fan sighed.

Then, he focused his attention on the Time Laws.

A long time ago, Lin Fan had wanted to level up his Time Laws.

Unfortunately, the condition to upgrade the Time Laws was to have ten laws reach the intermediate level.

Now, his space, metal, wood, water, fire, earth, life, death, yin, and yang had all reached the intermediate level. He finally had the chance to upgrade his Time Laws.

[Do you want to use the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem on the Time Laws?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve successfully leveled up.]

Instantly, a mysterious and unfathomable feeling surged into Lin Fan’s mind.

He slowly raised his hand, and the solid wood table in front of him became full of vitality in the blink of an eye, turning into a towering tree.

He touched the thick skin of the tree and the fresh leaves, finding it very strange.

Then, with a wave of his hand, the towering tree turned into a solid wood table again.

This was not an illusion, nor was it the power of the wood element. It was the true power of time.

Time reversed, time accelerated… It could be done casually!

At this moment, a loud voice sounded throughout the entire Earth.

[Planet Lord, I’m Qin Qiuliang of the Dragon Tiger Sect. I have no ill intentions. I’m looking for an invincible path to spar!]

…

Immediately, everyone on Earth started discussing and looking around.

“What was that sound just now?”

“What’s a Planet Lord?”

“Dragon Tiger Sect? Is there such a sect?”

“Where is he talking from?”

…

Lin Fan frowned and looked up into the sky.

He saw…

A white-robed man with a golden longsword in his hand stood in the air, looking down at Earth.

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Qin Qiuliang: Level-nine Domain Lord. A core disciple of the Dragon Tiger Sect. In order to find the path of invincibility, he challenges one powerhouse after another. He has an invincible heart.]

Lin Fan could not help but ask, “Isn’t the formation hiding Earth? Why can he see Earth?”

[Do you want to spend 10,000 spirit stones to inquire?]

“Yes!”

Instantly, the 10,000 spirit stones in Lin Fan’s internal space shattered like bubbles.

[Due to the Great Dao fragment, a special aura permeated the earth, causing the array formation to lose its concealment effect.]

Lin Fan could not help but look at the small mountain that was the Great Dao fragment in the distance and frown.

At this moment, Qin Qiuliang spoke again, “Are you looking down on me, Qin Qiuliang?”

His voice was like thunder, forming a rumbling sound.

The entire Earth was also stirred up.

He seemed to be a little angry.

It was as if a divine king was enraged.

Lin Fan still did not move. He used his Heavenly Eye to look at Qin Qiuliang again.

Even though his cultivation was only level-nine Domain Lord, what if it was extremely powerful?

After all, in some novels, most of the people who walked the path of invincibility had the ability to kill people of a higher level.

However, Lin Fan’s expression turned weird very quickly.

That was because, under the observation of the Heavenly Eye, Qin Qiuliang’s entire body was filled with weaknesses.

He could easily defeat him with a casual attack.

This was a genius?

Just this?

…

Qin Qiuliang was completely furious when no one responded.

“You’ve gone too far!”

As soon as he finished speaking, the aura around his body continued to rise, as if he had transformed into a giant that was even taller than the sky. He would strike a terrifying blow at any time. It would be a divine punishment that would completely destroy the earth.

It was also at this moment that Lin Fan appeared out of nowhere in the void.

Qin Qiuliang retracted his aura slightly and said, “Are you the master of this planet?”

Lin Fan said, “Maybe.”

He had lived in the universe for a period of time and knew the rules of this world.

The strong were respected!

Generally speaking, the strongest person on a planet was the master of the planet.

Lin Fan was without a doubt the strongest person on Earth.

“I think you heard what I said just now, right?” Qin Qiuliang said. “Don’t worry, we’re just sparring. It won’t hurt our lives, and there won’t be any grudges.

“Make your move!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he stood with his hands behind his back, extremely arrogant.

The weird look on Lin Fan’s face grew even more intense.

“You really want me to make the first move?”

“Yeah,” Qin Qiuliang said.

Lin Fan nodded and waved his hand at Qin Qiuliang.

Terrifying gales surged out like a storm that could obliterate everything.

A thin layer of sweat immediately appeared on Qin Qiuliang’s forehead. He wanted to dodge, but he realized that the surrounding space was like a swamp. The more he struggled, the more he could not move.

In the next moment…

Qin Qiuliang was blown away like dust.

Seeing this, Lin Fan stepped out and returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He looked at the mountain-like Great Dao fragment not far away.

For a moment, he hesitated.

The fragment of the Great Dao made it impossible for Earth to hide.

Should he abandon them?

When Lin Fan saw Hu Tian, Qiu Ziqian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others whose cultivation levels were increasing, he put this thought aside.

He could not lose them!

In fact, Hu Tian and the others were not the only ones who were affected by the Great Dao fragment and seeing rapid increase in their cultivation.

The reason why Lin Fan was able to reach level-two Universe in such a short period of time was because of the fragment as well.

He was not far from breaking through to level-three Universe, and it was also due to the Great Dao fragment.

The best defense was to become stronger in the shortest time possible.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Qin Qiuliang has a favorable impression of you. Current favorability is three stars.]

Lin Fan blinked his eyes.

What was going on?

Did he not just send the guy flying?

Not only did he not hate him, but he even had a good impression of him?

Did he like to be abused?
